story.title: Plants & Trees: Our Friends Forever
paragraphs_en: Plants & trees take time to grow, First a seed we have to sow. A little shoot so tender is seen, Water it regularly and it turns bright green. Some manure to nurture and add strength, Soon you will see it growing in length
Variety of plants around we see. Creepers that climb walls and trees, Shrubs with small branches that touch the earth. Tubes and Bulbs which are Roots or Layered. .
Then there are Aquatic plants that grow in water. Some beneath the surface and some bloom over. Water Chestnuts and duck-weeds hide deep under Lotus and Lilies on the surface they flower.

And the thick trunk Trees that stand tall, Green in Spring often dry in the Fall. Some bent with fruits or flowers Some stand erect like a tower. Found in many shapes and forms, Mango, Apple, Dates and Palms!

"A thousand benefits of plants" says Teacher. From a simple shade when its sunny; To giving us Food, Oxygen and Shelter. Plants and trees are friends that truly matter So lets us all plant trees Our Best Friends Forever!

sentences.text_en: From a simple shade when its sunny; To giving us Food, Oxygen and Shelter.

sentences.text_en: Plants and trees are friends that truly matter So lets us all plant trees Our Best Friends Forever!
